$comment: L2E-05-CTX-CHART: ctx chart rows (on-chart). Census claims OO shows chart-element rows (Axis Titles, Data Labels, Legend, Trendline, Error Bars, Up/Down Bars, Gridlines, Chart Title, Data Table) plus Edit data / Update field in the context menu on a chart. WO's #ctx-menu has NO chart-specific rows: the only chart-adjacent surface is data-showif="object" rows (wrap ops, ConvertToShape, EditPoints, ResizeToCell — verified live: right-click on the img.vector-object[data-kind=chart] fixture shows exactly those, EditObject stays hidden because isEditableObject() requires div.object, Distribute* stay hidden at <2 objects, FrameSettings/EquationSettings explicitly exclude img.vector-object[data-kind=chart]). The chartElement toggles the census points at live only in the chart-design ribbon rb-menu (hidden ul.menu-list, unreachable by the runner's hit-test — see chart-tab2.json $skipped) and the ctx pre cannot reach them. Empirical probe (right-click fixture chart): visible ctx items = Cut/Copy/Paste/lists/Undo/Redo/Bold/Italic/... + WrapInline/Square/Tight/Behind/Front/Through + EditWrapBoundary + ConvertToShape + EditPoints + ResizeToCell + UpdateField/UpdateTOC/... ; chart-design ribbon tab stays hidden (activation listens on editor 'click', a right-click never fires it).
